name: Li Wei
bio:
Li Wei's journey into motorsport security was unconventional. Starting as a computer science graduate, his exceptional analytical skills caught the attention of a local racing team during a cybersecurity vulnerability assessment. He quickly transitioned into security, applying his technical acumen to safeguard race assets and personnel.

At Sprint V8 Team, Li Wei takes a proactive, data-driven approach. He emphasizes preventative measures, using predictive analysis to identify potential security risks before they materialize. His ability to balance technical expertise with leadership qualities makes him a respected figure within the team, despite his preference for working independently.

Li Wei's blend of technical skills and strategic vision sets him apart. He is constantly seeking innovative solutions to emerging threats, ensuring that Sprint V8 Team remains at the forefront of motorsport security.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight fade on the sides
physical.description: Li Wei is of average height, with a lean build and an intense gaze.

quirks: Drinks copious amounts of green tea throughout the day.
Always carries a small notebook for jotting down security ideas, even during social events.
Has an uncanny ability to predict security breaches before they happen, often unsettling his colleagues.
